set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set routing-options multicast all-routes.explanation: Configure route options to support all multicast routers.

parameters.name: multicast-option
parameters.explanation: The multicast route option, and all multicast routers were supported.

set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001
set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term 1.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set protocols isis level 2 wide-metrics-.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

parameters.name: metric-type
parameters.explanation: Type of measure, wide-metrics-only indicates only width.

set protocols isis interface all.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols isis interface lo0 family.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]
set protocols isis interface lo0 family.command: set protocols isis interface lo0 family inet address 192.168.2.1
set protocols isis interface lo0 family.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的环回接口的IPv4地址。

set protocols isis level 2 disable.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

parameters.name: metric-type
parameters.explanation: Type of measure, wide-metrics-only indicates only width.

set protocols isis interface lo0 passive.command: set protocols isis interface lo0 passive
set protocols isis interface lo0 passive.explanation: Configures the loop back interface of the IS-IS protocol as passive mode.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: Interface mode, passive means passive mode.

set protocols isis area 0000.0000.0002.explanation: Configure an IS-IS protocol regional ID.

set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: This command enables Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast routing in Junos OS.

mode sparse.explanation: Configure the mode of PIM protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0 po.command: set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0 po.explanation: Configures the loop back interface of the IS-IS protocol as passive mode.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: Interface mode, passive means passive mode.

set protocols pim interface ge-2/0/0.explanation: This command enables Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast routing in Junos OS.

mode sparse.explanation: Configure the mode of PIM protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0 po.command: set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0 po.explanation: Configures the loop back interface of the IS-IS protocol as passive mode.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: Interface mode, passive means passive mode.

set protocols pim ssm default-group-rang.command: set protocols pim ssm default-group-range ACL-2001
set protocols pim ssm default-group-rang.explanation: Configure the default group range for PIM SSM.
